text: Requested by Sri (the owner). When planning escalates the planner to planner_revision_effort (xhigh) on a revision round, scale the planner's time limit with it, so a stronger revision is not cut off by the base planner_timeout_s of 600 s. Job 20261114-041123-hvyh failed this way: round 2 ran at xhigh for 606 s and hit the 600 s deadline.
